data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'hurdeos', meaning 'sturdy, firm'. In ancient Greek culture, Hurd was a name given to those who were strong and resilient. The name Hurd carries the meaning “Sturdy, Firm” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Hurd usually hope their child will grow to embody sturdy, firm and live with faith, good character and purpose.

Today, the name Hurd is a reminder of our Christian heritage and the values of perseverance and endurance that have shaped Western culture.
